quest.title: A Tricky Situation
quest.description: The situation in Inazuma has stabilized, but neither you nor Paimon has been idle. You decide to head over to the Adventurers' Guild and accept a new commission...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

talks.objective: Go to the Adventurers' Guild in Inazuma City

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Hello, Traveler. You couldn't have come at a better time.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: The Adventurers' Guild has received a new commission, but it's a little complicated. We've struggled to find the right candidate for the job.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lay it on me, it's starting to feel like eternity around here.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I'll get straight to the point. The client is a distinctive musician from Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: She's in possession of a temporary travel permit that's about to expire, and is looking for someone familiar with the process to help her renew it and avoid deportation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Does this really count as adventuring...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, wipe that disappointed look off your face! Imagine if you were in that situation!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, a distinctive female musician from Liyue... sounds familiar...

choices.text: Remembering really isn't your strong suit, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Ah! Paimon knows!

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Oh? Is she a friend of yours? She headed for the Tenryou Commission after submitting her request, you should be able to find her there.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: I hear that the Commission has been very busy recently, so they probably won't be able to help her...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If it's who Paimon thinks it is, she's probably introducing the Tenryou Commission to some sweet riffs right now!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm not sure that would end well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: B—But doesn't everyone love rock 'n' roll...? Hmm, we should probably get over there before she gets arrested for public disorder!

talks.objective: Go to the Tenryou Commission Headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So it is Xinyan! Ha! Paimon's intuition prevails again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You couldn't even remember her name just now...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Huh? Well, I'll be! Paimon, Traveler, what are you two doing here!?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Never thought I'd run into familiar faces so far from home! If you're here for a performance, I'm afraid I gotta disappoint you.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: *sigh* It's a long story.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Have you heard of the Iridescence Tour? It's okay if you haven't... I didn't hear about it until just recently.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: The more I think about it, this whole thing was weird from the get-go!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: The organizers told me it was a music festival from Fontaine that was famous throughout Teyvat, but it seemed like nobody in Liyue had ever heard of it before.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: There was a guy standing on the side of the road calling out, like he was selling Sunsettias or somethin'... I only inquired because I felt bad for him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aww, that was nice of you...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Well anyway, he showed me a ton of material — the Iridescence Tour is a big deal over in Fontaine.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I heard that gettin' stage time means your music might start to be heard far and wide.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, you'd be famous overnight if you were up there!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: You think so? Me too! I want as many folks as possible to hear my music — that's why I'm so set on attendin' the festival.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: This year's Iridescence Tour is bein' held here in Inazuma. I've been honin' a bunch of new songs since I signed up — I even asked Beidou to ferry me out here ahead of time to scout the place out and make sure everythin' goes perfect.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Xiangling made me up a special packed lunch to wish me well! But... the organizers...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: They ran into trouble out on the ocean — they can't make it. They even got fishing boats to send a message to Inazuma so the authorities could start spreadin' the word — the Iridescence Tour is canceled!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: How can they just cancel it like that? I come here to perform, and they tell me this after I arrive? Now there's no way of getting the travel permit that the organizers arranged for me, and my temporary travel permit here is about to expire. Things couldn't have gone much worse...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems like no one was more excited than you about performing at the festival, why should you get the short end of the stick...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's not fair...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yeah...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: *sigh* It ain't always easy being a musician...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Well shucks, enough complainin'. This ain't the first time I wasn't able to perform. Time to move on!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, you sure cheered up quick!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: If you wanna play rock 'n' roll for a livin', you gotta be tenacious! That's why I sprang into action. I submitted a request at the Adventurers' Guild and headed straight to the Tenryou Commission to see what else I could find out.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: However... I've been standing here for ages already. I'm not sure what's keepin' those Tenryou Commission samurai so busy that they don't even have time to say hi.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How dare they! Paimon bets they're just goofing off!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: It's fine, stuff like this is bound to happen when you step onto unfamiliar shores. Hey Traveler, Beidou told me you've been in Inazuma for a while now. You must know how to get things done 'round here, right? Think you can help me out?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't sweat it, I'm on the case.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Now we're talkin'! If you can get my permit straightened out, I'll write you a killer tune as a token of my heartfelt gratitude.

talks.objective: Negotiate with the officials at the Tenryou Commission Headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Yata Kouki
dialogues.text: Huh? You again? I thought I told you we're busy already! You'll have to wait.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Sorry fellas, perhaps my agent here can explain.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is Kujou Sara here?

dialogues.speaker: Yata Kouki
dialogues.text: Madam Kujou Sara...? Oh, you must be the Traveler...

dialogues.speaker: Yata Kouki
dialogues.text: Is this outsider girl a friend of yours?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure is! She got stood up and now she's stuck here, so she needs to extend her travel permit. Come on, what kind of impression are you guys creating for visitors here, hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Yata Kouki
dialogues.text: Please don't be mistaken, we're not purposely delaying anything. Something big happened recently and the Tenryou Commission is spread thin — we don't have the resources right now.

dialogues.speaker: Yata Kouki
dialogues.text: The reason this young lady is still in the queue isn't because she came later than anyone else, it's because there's no one free to take care of smaller issues like travel permits.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, what is this "something big"?

dialogues.speaker: Yata Kouki
dialogues.text: *sigh* I can't tell you any more. Madam Kujou Sara is in the courtyard. Ask her yourself if you want to understand the situation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like we don't have much choice.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So they really are busy...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Seems that way! But that's OK, they're just doing their job.

dialogues.speaker: Yata Kouki
dialogues.text: Madam Kujou Sara is in the courtyard, you can try asking her yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Formations! Follow the vanguard and assemble outside the city!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Hmm? Traveler? And who else do we have here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry for interrupting your work.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: No harm done. What brings you to the Tenryou Commission headquarters all of a sudden? Is there trouble afoot?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Because if there's anything I can help with, don't hesitate to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Finally, someone who can call the shots!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I see, it's regrettable that your friend has run into such an unfortunate incident, especially after such a journey.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission is experiencing a large turnover of personnel in very difficult circumstances. We really are short on people. I apologize for not having tended to your friend's request on time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's rare to see you guys struggling like this. What is it this time?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We don't mean to pry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah! We're just... casually asking...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: No one's to blame here, seems I just arrived at a bad time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about we make a deal?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! Why don't you tell us what kind of trouble you're facing, and we'll do our best to help? In return, maybe you could help Xinyan extend her travel permit?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: ...We really could use the extra help, especially from capable individuals like yourselves...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Alright, here's the situation. Recently, a nameless Domain has appeared in the Araumi region. Monsters with incredible strength have been pouring into the area.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, surely the Tenryou Commission are used to dealing with monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: The Domain appeared quite unexpectedly, and we've come under serious pressure. I've already sent out scouts to investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Originally, I was planning to lead a force there myself... but an extended period on the front lines would leave the Tenryou Commission without oversight... it just didn't feel right.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: If you need folks who can fight, I'll wager we can certainly be of assistance! Ain't that right, Traveler?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We do you a favor, and you do us a favor. Got it?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Geez, are you really giving orders to a general, Paimon?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Hehe, it's fine, I'm indebted to you. This really is the best solution at the moment.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: If it were anyone else, I'd have to refuse... but even the Almighty Shogun has recognized your abilities, Traveler. I'm happy to assign this task to you.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Say now, sounds like you've made quite a name for yourself in Inazuma...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You know me...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I'm gettin' to! Xiangling and the other folks are always sayin' you're destined for big things...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Madam Kujou Sara, where should we go next?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: I'll take you over to the location now. I should warn you that I haven't been there myself yet, so I'm not sure how dangerous things could get...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: As a precaution, please bring sufficient combat equipment and supplies with you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, can we write off the expenses?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Fair enough, I'll put in a request now...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Hold up! I remember there's a travel permit processin' fee, why don't you write that off and I'll cover all our other expenses.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How generous of you, Xinyan!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: It's nothin', actually Beidou gave me a bag of Mora to spend before I even got off the ship! Seein' as I'm inconveniencin' just about everyone, it's about time I had somethin' to show for it.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Why don't we just split it between us? It should cover equipment and supplies, no trouble.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: ...You are a woman of method and integrity, I see.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Aww, don't mention it... but don't go forgettin' about my permit now...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: I will see to it personally, you have nothing to worry about.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Fantastic! Thank you Ma'am!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So it's agreed? Alright, let's take care of this Domain!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Sounds like a plan. Let's hit the road!

talks.objective: Go into the domain to investigate

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: Ma'am, you're finally here!

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: We were ambushed by monsters at the entrance as soon as we started to investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: We were able to push most of them back into the Domain, but... some of them escaped to the southeast...

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: Many of our troops were injured, so I decided to tend to them before issuing the order to pursue. Forgive me!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Southeast? Oh no, there'll be civilians along the way...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: This is urgent, we need to split up for now. I'll lead a team to pursue the monsters that got away. The situation here I leave in your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I'm sure you don't need reminding... but be careful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry about a thing, we got this!

response.speaker: Watanabe
response.text: Uhh... one more thing! Monsters often try to sneak out from the Domain. Keep a close watch on the entrance and don't let any of them past, or else—

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Watanabe! Trust in my judgment!

response.speaker: Watanabe
response.text: Y—Yes, Ma'am!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And off she goes.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Wow, she ain't playin', huh.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, she is leading an army after all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, let's get over to the entrance!

talks.objective: Go to the domain and guard the gate

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's just... a piece of paper?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like a little paper figure. Is it a talisman? Maybe one of the samurai dropped it.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: A paper figure, huh... reminds me of the shikigami they talk about in the legends.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shikigami?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Yeah. I spend a lotta time looking into legends from all over Teyvat — they give me inspiration for my lyrics.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: They say in Inazuma there are paper cut-outs imbued with magical power that follow their masters wherever they go. Some of them can banish evil, repel monsters, or even protect your home.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds a bit like all that sigil and adepti art stuff they have over in Liyue...

choices.text: Sounds like I need to trade Paimon in for paper and scissors...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!? Paimon is a professional Teyvat travel guide AND your best friend! Let's see your fighting origami do that!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Wait! Look! The shikigami... It's... it's movin'!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey there, lil' paper guy! Can you hear us? Can you talk?
Where am I...? Ah! Did I faint?
Oh no... I'm... Wait! Did you see the monsters that escaped from here? Where did they go?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: There were monsters around here alright, but we took care of all of 'em.
Phew... Thank you. And thank goodness they didn't manage to escape... I'd never forgive myself if someone got hurt...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you a shikigami? Those monsters... you didn't let them out, right?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: To my knowledge, shikigami are all about defeating monsters... so what's your story?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: My name is Shiki Taishou, and I'm sorry you have to see me like this on our first meeting.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: This Domain is called the Mystic Onmyou Chamber. I'm the overseer in charge here.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: The Mystic Onmyou Chamber has been in an extended slumber, just as I have. However, a few days ago, under the influence of an unknown power, all the monsters in the Domain were suddenly awakened... and the door was opened...

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Actually... it seems like I may have suffered some memory loss in the process. All I remember is waking up to a living nightmare... I tried my best to stop them.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I was surprised to see the monsters turn into paper charms when they were defeated. That's when I remembered that they must also be onmyoudou creations... and form part of this onmyou chamber, like me.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Onmyoudou creations? I don't follow...

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I'm sorry... I can't give you a clear explanation right now...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But... what about yourself?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Me...? M—My sincere apologies! I am a shikigami, but all I know is that I'm the overseer responsible for this Domain. I can't remember who my master is, or why I was created in the first place. *sigh* I'm a failure...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean, you don't even know if you're one of the good guys?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, don't worry! Paimon heard that those with memory loss sometimes start to remember things when they return to a familiar place. Why don't you try going back into the Domain?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I was just about to try that.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I still have many unanswered questions, but one thing I'm certain of is that my powers originate from this Domain... We might even be one and the same.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: For some reason... I have a feeling that I should be able to completely control it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If shikigami are supposed to help with banishing evil and repelling monsters, you were probably stationed here to guard the entrance!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As for your memory loss, did you ever hear those stories? Y'know, the ones where someone loses their memory and forgets about the incredible powers they had. Once they remember, they become invincible again!

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Actually, I was just thinking along those lines... Do you think you all can help me out?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The most urgent task is helping you to remember, right? Once your memory's back, you might be able to control the Domain again, and stop any more monsters from escaping.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Traveler, can I borrow you for a second?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: This Shiki Taishou has only just woken up, and it's lost part of its memory... Do you trust it?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...I'm not sure.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: If it really is a guardian of the Domain, then we're in good company... but if it's not...

choices.text: We can't rule out the opposite.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: ...Exactly. We shouldn't make any foregone conclusions, but we still gotta be careful.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Besides, we still don't know who built this Domain, or why there are so many monsters inside. We need to get more of an understandin'.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Paimon on the other hand seems to trust it quite a bit. I guess she's still a child at heart.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon has a thing for cute pieces of paper.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Hold on there, Paimon. Let's get a grasp of the situation before we get too hasty.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Mm... I understand. Between my mysterious memory loss and my link to this onmyou chamber, it's normal for you to have your doubts.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Why don't you let me test your sincerity?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sincerity? Sounds like something interesting is about to happen...!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: You may not believe it, but music lovers like myself are able to use a special kinda language, that isn't used by ordinary folks. This language can be transmitted to others in the form of music itself.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I see...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Special language? Paimon wants to hear it!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: It's an honest language that touches the truest depths of the heart. I'll be using this language to perform a test, to see if our friend Shiki Taishou here is truly trustworthy.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Music? That's not something I have much experience with... But I'm willing to accept any trials you deem necessary. All I want to do is take care of the crisis at hand.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Alright, well then listen up and look lively!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: So! Hope your spines ain't shiverin' too much.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The performance was spectacular...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...But you only played one song! Is that enough for the test?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: The language I spoke was hidden in the music. You won't notice it, but it'll find its way into your heart... and expand your mind.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Every soul reacts differently to this kinda language. Just tell me how it made you feel, and I'll tell you the color of your soul!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!? That sounds amazing!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: A kind heart, a heart forced into evil deeds, a heart closed off from having grown used to misfortune... all of them come in different colors.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: So, Shiki Taishou, tell me. What did my music make you feel?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I'm sorry, I... I'm not sure I understand.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I've never heard music like this before, so it's impossible for me to grasp the hidden intricacies.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: What I can say is that my body and soul... if I have a soul... has been uplifted by your melody. I can see the world that you described.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: World?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I'm not sure how to put it... but it felt like I was wandering aimlessly on a path, with a mist all around me. It felt like I was wounded... and my head was aching.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: There were sounds coming from beyond the mist that frightened me, and I worried I was about to be swallowed by some hidden danger. But all I could do was continue forward.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I didn't know where my destination was... but it felt like someone was waiting there for me.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's... very detailed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... That's a lot of feels for a piece of paper, maybe Paimon failed the test. All Paimon could think of was a bunch of people eating Grilled Fish...

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Grilled Fish! I think I saw something similar to that... I was grilling fish with people whose faces I couldn't make out.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: There was a fire at the end of the mist. People were sitting around with freshly caught fish on bamboo skewers... I'd transformed into an actual person — I was having dinner with them.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: ...And yet I had the feeling that I'd be leaving and continuing on my way again once the sun rose.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: An endless journey... and there wasn't any fightin'?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Mighty interestin'... So my melody didn't conjure up any thoughts of fightin' for you?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Oh... should it have?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: No, no, you gave a great answer. I had a few friends listen to that tune before as well. Your answer really reminded me of theirs...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: As far as songs go, it's pretty complex, with a lotta twists and turns, but the image you had prevailed the whole way through... You must be very similar to those friends of mine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you talking about Xiangling and Beidou?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Haha, that's right!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I'll wager you're a like-minded bein'! Based on your answer, I'm willing to trust you.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: ...Really? I was just trying to describe how I felt, I didn't think you'd be able to trust me so quickly.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: That's because this is all still mysterious to you! I have no doubt about the language of music. It tells me who I can trust.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Music ain't bound to anythin' — it's free in the truest sense of the word. Shiki Taishou, to me, out of all the things you could have thought of, the images you landed on make me feel like we were supposed to run into you.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Thank you very much, young lady!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: No need to thank me, trusting you is an extension of my belief in my musical intuition. Not to strum my own chord or anythin', hehe.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Well, this is all just my own opinion, and everyone's entitled to theirs. But for the moment, it seems like we're all in the same boat either way. Traveler, I hope you can see to allowin' Shiki Taishou to tag along for now.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I—I will never forget the kindness you've all shown me! I'm certain I can be of help to you... if only I can regain my memories.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Oh, enough of that. We're not helpin' you because we need somethin' from you. The most important thing now is to prepare ourselves for what lies ahead.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Traveler, we better get combat-ready. Let's see what this here Domain has to offer!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Maybe we can take care of everythin' before Madam Kujou Sara gets back!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: For adventurers at our level, there isn't a Domain out there that we can't handle!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: No kiddin'? Hahah, I'm lucky to have friends with such great taste in music!

choices.text: If its purpose is to create monsters...
Sounds strong enough not to warrant a "fifths of a wild boar" measuring system...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Strange... the Mystic Onmyou Chamber doesn't look special in any way.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: True, but I can sense my power regenerating... Whew, I feel much better now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait! Look over there! Is there... someone here already?

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Someone inside the Domain? I... I can't believe it. Who would choose to enter a Domain like this one...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They look familiar...
Oh? I was wondering who it could be, but it seems you—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That voice...!
I heard your footsteps and thought: Who in Teyvat would set foot in such a dangerous Domain...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! It's you!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Then I heard your voice and well... Haha, it all made sense.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: It's been a long time, Traveler. You're getting bolder.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Childe! What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Domain, wait... Are you responsible for all this!?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: "Child?" He's on the tall side isn't he?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hello miss, Tartaglia will do just fine, I'm—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon'll tell you who he is! He's someone who shows up before bad things happen!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hey now, all this time apart and this is the greeting I get?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—You know what Paimon's talking about!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Wait, Xinyan doesn't know what Paimon's talking about...! And knowing Xinyan, if she found out about Childe's actions in Liyue... Oh boy...)

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: (Hmm, interesting attire, but I think she's a Liyue girl... Now then, perhaps I should just be upfront...?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, uh... H—How about this—

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Actually, I want to start by—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This is an adventurer we befriended in Mondstadt! Childe is just a nickname we gave him!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Eh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: T—Tartaglia here is allllways messing stuff up! Even when the dangers are obvious, he just recklessly charges in — something an adventurer should NEVER do! So we get a lil' annoyed with him sometimes, hehe...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: ...Uhh... Yes! Yes, yes — I couldn't have put it better myself. I too am an adventurer, and I've caused my fair share of trouble for Paimon and the Traveler here, for which I'm... unfathomably sorry.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Impressive, Paimon, impressive.)

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Oh, so you're a Mondstadter! Pleasure to meet ya, I'm from Liyue myself. The name's Xinyan, and the name of the game is rock 'n' roll!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: The pleasure's all mine. So, are you here to explore the Domain too?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: That's right, we're trying to find out why the monsters here are so active.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: According to Shiki Taishou here, this Domain is known as the Mystic Onmyou Chamber. There are lots of dangerous monsters inside that were created using onmyoudou.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: A Domain that lets its monsters escape in the outside world... What forces are at play here?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: As for me, I stumbled in almost by accident, but now I'm curious about this mystery. We adventurers don't rest until the truth comes to light — it's in our nature. So, do you mind if I join you guys? I can offer my aid in return.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: If you haven't heard, I'm pretty handy in a fight...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Traveler, what do you think?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: You're not going to reject me, are you? Oh, don't be so cruel, Traveler — you know how strong I am!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, you can join us.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Heh, now we're talking.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Another addition to the Shiki Taishou memory huntin' crew! There's strength in numbers, haha.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I'm assuming Shiki Taishou is the little paper fellow here, right?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hmm... A simple yet captivating design, and look at the little face! I bet my brother would love one.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Uhh... Is he complimenting me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Yeah, take it as a compliment.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Ahem, alright, why don't I bring our new companion up to speed?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: You said that you're the overseer here... but I didn't see you when I entered. That must mean you were already unconscious by the time I arrived, correct?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I believe so.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Well brother, maybe if you'd slowed down a little bit you would have noticed.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Brother? Haha, that's a very intimate way of addressing someone — I like it! You remind me of my little sister...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: So, according to the information we have, it's very possible that Shiki Taishou is the guardian of this Domain.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I'm sure we'll find out the truth of that soon enough. Shiki Taishou also says that its power has been regenerating ever since it set foot here. It might even be able to absorb more power the further in we go.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Shiki Taishou, can you remember anythin' yet? Or, do you feel different in any way?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: They say that everything about shikigami is derived from magic... perhaps the more powerful our friend here becomes, the more likely it is that they'll recover their memories.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Now that I've been here a little while, I have a vague sense that I should be able to control certain parts of this Domain... Overseers are supposed to have that ability.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I've taken care of the monsters in this room. They all turned into tattered paper charms when I defeated them.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: *sigh* That was some exhilarating combat, but I'm afraid I can't seem to find a way to progress further. Shiki Taishou, as our resident overseer, do you have any tricks up your sleeve?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Allow me to give it a try... Haa!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: What in tarnation? The door opened!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... anyone else getting the creeps here? It looks real eerie. Someone else go in front! Childe, how about you?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I smell danger.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: It's the scent of monsters... the aroma of battle.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: The monsters here are strong, fierce fighting awaits us... but I wouldn't have it any other way. You guys should learn to see the fun side of combat.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I don't care how strong they are, they'll be ashes when I'm finished with them!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: M—Make sure you guys protect us! Especially Paimon...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What is it, Shiki Taishou?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I hear something... an echo.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: This place... Yes, this used to be my dominion! I should be able to do more than just open doors and activate mechanisms here.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Fight... I—I should know how to fight!

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Everyone! I've just remembered some combat techniques. Please, allow me to assist you in battle with shikifuda and onmyoudou.

talks.objective: Go deeper into The Ominous Demesne

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: We must tend to the wounded quickly and consolidate our position...

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission must not falter, no matter the odds!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even if the situation's looking grim, he's still super focused. Seems like a dedicated samurai to Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Not bad, that was some perilous action... I've experienced close calls like that before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No surprise to see Childe enjoying himself. Do you really enjoy fighting that much?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Of course! I relish this kind of endless fighting. Putting your life on the line, giving your all, and leaving nothing on the battlefield...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... I guess bringing Childe along does have its advantages. We're making quick work of these monsters!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hey! Watch your step! What is that?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: This paper cut-out looks just like Shiki Taishou!

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: I know what this is. It's a replica of me — a mass-produced shikigami based on my design. It has my power... and possibly a portion of my memories...

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: I should fuse with it.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: How was it? What did you see?

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Harunosuke...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Harunosuke?

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: My master, Kamuna Harunosuke.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: He was the first onmyouji of Inazuma and a master of charm magic. He created me and this Domain, and lived here in seclusion for a very long time.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Huh, so it was your master that created this place.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: But what was his reason behind creatin' you and the Domain?

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: I'm sorry... I'm not sure of that myself just yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Perhaps he was passionate about onmyoudou? Maybe when he discovered how strong he was, he decided to create a place like this to hone his abilities, to become even stronger...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: It's possible. Those obsessed with certain disciplines are often capable of incredible feats.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Perhaps that was the case with Kamuna Harunosuke. Onmyoudou may have been everything to him, so he created a Domain to train in.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: But, he couldn't foresee that something would go wrong with the Domain, that he would lose control of the onmyoudou, and that his shikigami would turn into monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wah! Shikigami can turn into monsters!?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Th—That's not possible, right!? That could be bad news for us!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: I'm just shooting in the dark here. If the monsters weren't originating from the shikigami or paper charms, where were they coming from? The Inazuman authorities must have caught wind of this place and sent people here to seal it off, sending Shiki Taishou into a deep sleep in the process...

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: No. Even though I still can't recall what he looked like, or how it felt to be in his company, there is one thing I'm certain of...

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: With his ability, there's no way Kamuna would have made an error like this with his onmyoudou. More importantly, I'm sure he wouldn't have been so irresponsible.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Oh really? Well then, that leaves us with the worst assumption of all.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: What if Kamuna Harunosuke is evil, and created this Domain to enhance his onmyoudou? What if he succeeded in creating monsters that could become weapons...?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: That would make him a problem, and you... you would be his accomplice.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Evil? Accomplice? Using monsters... as weapons?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Easy red, isn't it a little early to be jumping to conclusions?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Shiki Taishou passed my test and earned my trust. I don't like the way you're talkin'.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Hey, I'm merely making inferences based on Shiki Taishou's memories. I'm not trying to cast doubt on him, and it's true that we don't have any decisive evidence. But we do need to understand the situation here.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Besides... is being used as a weapon really that bad?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Being used as a weapon...?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (He must know something.)

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Alright, the next room should be through that door.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Let's see if we can find more of Shiki Taishou's replicas and help him restore his memories.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Who knows? We may even find Kamuna Harunosuke himself somewhere further in. I wonder how strong of a fighter he is... I'd like to go a few rounds with him.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: ...Let's keep moving forward.

talks.objective: Go deeper into The Ominous Demesne

dialogues.speaker: Yata Kouki
dialogues.text: I still have to go and check the left corridor after finishing my post...

dialogues.speaker: Yata Kouki
dialogues.text: If only we had more help...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That guy looks busy, let's not disturb him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? How did we get back out here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wasn't that door meant to take us to the next room?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Uh-oh, where's Shiki Taishou and Red? Are they still in the Domain?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh no... we can't get back in. It's stoppin' outsiders from enterin'.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Domain is stopping us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's that rumbling... Can you feel it? Maybe some kind of mechanism has activated inside?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: ...Ugh, this ain't good.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: We can't make any hasty decisions... Traveler, Paimon, let's just wait it out for a minute.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Hey!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? Kujou Sara? You're back so soon!

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Not soon enough, we spent a long time chasing those monsters down. They were cunning, and surprisingly good at evading us.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: How are things looking here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, actually...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: No other monsters have emerged since we defeated the ones at the entrance.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: However, strange noises keep comin' from inside the Domain. Something big must be happenin', but we reckon it might be too dangerous to enter. We're waitin' for the noises to stop before goin' in to investigate.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Hmm... I can sense a power is resisting us.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: We've already expended a lot of strength intercepting those monsters, investigating the truth of this Domain would be difficult... We need to be fully prepared.

response.speaker: Watanabe
response.text: Ma'am! It's not looking good for the wounded soldiers, but we came across a few scattered monsters on the way back...

response.speaker: Watanabe
response.text: If I may be so bold... we need you to bring up the rear and escort the wounded back to the city!

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: I suppose it can't be helped. I'll send the wounded back to Inazuma City and dispatch an elite force here. You've already been a great help, please return to the city with us.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: That's mighty kind Madam Kujou, but we're not outta strength yet. In fact, we've plenty to go around! We can keep taking care of things here, you do what you gotta do.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: We'll keep a close eye on the entrance for you.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: I... I'm very grateful.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Hehe, if we're gonna help someone, we're gonna help them all the way through to the end.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We can get a fire going and eat some Grilled Fish while you're away! Mmmm...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I just got a wave of new inspiration! I'm gonna write a song about this daredevil trip to Inazuma.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: We at the Tenryou Commission will forever remember your contributions to our cause. I will be sure to reward each and every one of you properly once this is all over.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: For now, I'll leave this Domain in your hands. Please keep a careful watch.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Watanabe will be stationed in the area. Be sure to alert him if anything unexpected happens.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Xinyan, did you leave out the part about us entering the Domain on purpose? Hehe... Don't think Paimon didn't notice!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Haha, you got me. Great minds think alike Paimon, you must've been fixin' to do the same.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: There's still a lot we don't know about the Domain. If we get the authorities involved... we might end up with more problems than we started with.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Now let me be clear, I ain't biased in favor of Shiki Taishou! It's just, those memories are really important to him. Before we find out the truth about his origin... we shouldn't go makin' assumptions.

choices.text: Seemed like Tartaglia was making a few.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Yeah, and it's a terrible feelin' to be misunderstood... I would know. Sometimes people are too ready to judge a book by its cover, and don't have the patience to read the pages...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Sometimes a glance is all it takes. And once someone's misunderstood, they got a hell of a job tryin' to change people's minds.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Rock 'n' roll is great music, but it's also easily misunderstood... I made a friend of Shiki Taishou as soon as he heard the language I was speakin'. I need to find my own way of helpin' him.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: That's right, we're gonna have to prove Shiki Taishou's innocence before she returns.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I need to ask a favor. Can you guys keep the Tenryou Commission's campaign against the Domain a secret from Shiki Taishou?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're really considerate, Xinyan. You really care about Shiki Taishou's memory loss.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Haha, could I call myself a friend if I didn't?

choices.text: (Xinyan can take care of the trust-building exercises...)

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Huh? There's that noise again! Let me take a look...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, Paimon wants to take a look too—

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon, come here a second!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you really think we should tell him?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Then again, if he turns on us when we lay it all out there, Paimon will have your back!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's no way we're losing to a tiny paper cut-out. Not on Paimon's watch!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Traveler, come quick!

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: *whimper* ...I failed again!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Shiki Taishou! Are you okay?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I'm fine, I had to use up some of my power just now to counter the resistance from within the Domain.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: The door just now must have actually been a disguised mechanism. As soon as anyone touches it, all the rooms inside the onmyou chamber are rearranged.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: It seems that no one can enter during the transition.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: *sigh* It's all my fault. If only I could exert real control over the Domain, we wouldn't be in this situation...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's no need to go blaming yourself. By the way, where's Childe? He's not still inside, is he?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I couldn't say... but that man possesses an incredible aura.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: He's unlike any ordinary person... He enjoys fighting and knows no fear of it. Maybe someone like that really can succeed in conquering this Domain.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He's a troublemaker, but he could be in serious danger right now. We can't let him perish in there! He's the strongest on the team!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: He was hardly breakin' a sweat in there. I think we should have faith in his abilities.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: As much as I hate sittin' around, if even Shiki Taishou can't get back in, there's not much we can do right now...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: *sigh* Well, while we're waitin', I'm gonna think about my song. Shiki Taishou, you wanna listen to some new music?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I'd love too, but my mind is restless...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you're a piece of paper, are you really more restless than we are?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Trust me when I say that I'm well aware of the risks you're taking to help me. The experiences, battles, and injuries you've gone through in the Domain are all my responsibility.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Us Liyue folk are all about maintainin' a tranquil mind. Things will only get worse if you let frustration take a hold of you.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: But there are some things in life that resist the more you try to repress them, that makes for freedom the more you try to tie 'em down. That's the kind of tenacity that gets me fired up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're talking about things like rock 'n' roll, right?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Right on! It's powerful yet flexible, with a stubbornness that never surrenders to the challenges ahead. That's the existence I strive for.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: ...I see. Then let us wait for the opportune moment together, Miss Xinyan.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Haha, now that's more like it!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Well Traveler, if you got other matters to attend to, let's split up for the meantime.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: We can rendezvous somewhere close by when the Domain is open again!

choices.text: Kujou Sara's given us some added time pressure.
Go and help those more in need.
(...or things might get out of hand real fast.)
